title_candidates: Thinking Machines releases Inkling with open weights
summary: Inkling is a 975-billion-parameter multimodal model with downloadable weights, an Apache 2.0 license, and hardware needs far beyond a normal computer.

primary_source.title: Inkling: Our Open-Weights Model
primary_source.author: Thinking Machines Lab
key_facts: Inkling has 975 billion total parameters and 41 billion active parameters.
It supports text, image, and audio inputs with text output and up to one million tokens of context.
Its weights are downloadable and hosted access is available through Tinker and third parties.

supporting_sources.title: Inkling Model Card
key_facts: The model card lists Apache 2.0, a separate acceptable-use policy, and minimum GPU memory of 600 GB for NVFP4 or 2 TB for BF16.

supporting_sources.title: Inkling
key_facts: The product page links to hosted trials, the announcement, model card, and weights.

steps.instruction: Review the license, acceptable-use policy, modalities, and context limits.
Compare the published hardware minimum with your available infrastructure.
Use a hosted path for a small verified test if local deployment is impractical.

risk_flags: Open weights do not make this a consumer local model.
The license and acceptable-use policy both apply.
